self-host:dragos-com.summary: Vulnerability disclosure policy for the OT security vendor, covering the Dragos Platform, hardware, services and threat intelligence solutions. Submissions go to psirt@dragos.com and may be anonymous, research in line with the policy is treated as authorised under anti-hacking and anti-circumvention law, and Dragos follows a 90-day disclosure policy.

self-host:salv-com.summary: Salv, an anti-financial-crime platform, runs its own vulnerability disclosure policy with reports sent by email. The first reporter of an issue that leads to a code or configuration change goes in its Security Researcher Hall of Fame; there are no bounties or other rewards. Salv won't pursue or support legal action over research that follows the guidelines, and asks you to keep findings confidential until they're resolved.
